purpose: Original English editorial content for Agrico programme detail pages (route /<slug>). Adapted from docs/content/universities-2026-10-30/content-contract.json and page-content-requirements.json. Content preparation only; do not seed CMS records.
file_rule: One JSON file per programme: docs/content/programmes-2026-11-01/<slug>.json. Valid JSON, UTF-8, no comments.

output_shape.name: full programme name as commonly published in India, e.g. 'B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture'
output_shape.discipline: e.g. Agriculture, Horticulture, Agricultural Engineering, Veterinary Science, Fisheries Science, Agribusiness
output_shape.duration: verified normal duration string, e.g. '4 years (8 semesters)'
output_shape.regulator: body whose curriculum/accreditation framework applies, e.g. 'ICAR (Sixth Deans Committee)', 'Veterinary Council of India'; null if unclear

overview.heading: original informative heading
paragraphs: 2-3 original factual paragraphs, roughly 150-230 words total

who_should_apply: 3-5 original bullets describing student interests/strengths that fit

curriculum.heading: original heading
curriculum.intro: original 40-80 word intro; say subject names vary by university

courses: representative course/subject areas from the ICAR/regulator curriculum

specialisations: electives / majors where supported, else empty

practical_learning.name: e.g. RAWE, Experiential Learning Programme, thesis research, internship

points: verified, regulator/typical entry requirements; say 'varies by university' where it does

routes.name: e.g. 'ICAR AIEEA (PG)', 'CUET-UG (ICAR quota seats)', 'State agricultural entrance / counselling', 'University entrance or merit'

steps.title: applicant step
steps.text: general applicant action, not invented institutional procedure

documents: commonly requested documents, phrased as 'usually' — only if supported

fees.summary: original explanation of how fees differ (state SAU vs private/deemed, government vs management quota). Do NOT state numeric fees unless an official source with academic year is cited in observed_examples.
fees.verification: not_verified unless every example is from an official dated source

careers.heading: original heading
public_sector_routes: e.g. IBPS AFO, state agriculture officer exams, ICAR ASRB/ARS/NET — only where relevant and real

seo.title: programme + course details/eligibility/admission; under 65 chars; no ranking claims

related: 2-4 slugs from the assigned slug list in this project

sources.url: exact URL actually read or seen as search excerpt
sources.title: source title

research_rules: Use web search for every programme. Prefer regulator and official sources: ICAR (Sixth Deans Committee UG curricula, ICAR PG/PhD syllabi BSMA 2021/2022, ICAR AIEEA/CUET notices via NTA), VCI (MSVE 2016 for B.V.Sc. & A.H.), state agricultural universities (TNAU, PAU, GBPUAT, IARI, etc.) programme pages. Secondary sites (Shiksha, Collegedunia, Careers360) may only supply leads; confirm important facts with official sources.

Write original copy from factual notes. Do not copy or lightly paraphrase other publishers' distinctive wording. No testimonials, rankings, 'best/top' superlatives, placement percentages or salary figures.
Do not guess. Unknown scalar facts are null; unavailable arrays are empty and get a verification_gaps entry. Date volatile facts (exam patterns, seat quotas, fees) by the actual source year.
Keep the content programme-level (India-wide). Say clearly where eligibility, fees, admission route or subject names vary by university or state.
Target about 700-1100 useful original words per programme across all fields. Specificity over length; no filler.
5-7 FAQs per programme covering eligibility, admission/exams, curriculum/practical learning, careers and higher study.

Only write inside D:/agrico-frontend/docs/content/programmes-2026-11-01/. Do not modify application source, CMS records or other agents' files. Do not bypass any access block; record it as a verification gap.
